_comment: Prefilled Google Form for reader feedback. UNCONFIGURED as shipped: an empty
form_url renders NO control anywhere on the site, and the rendered HTML stays
byte-identical to a build without this feature. That is deliberate, so the code
can merge before the form exists.
TO LIGHT IT UP: create the form (short-answer / paragraph questions only -
checkbox questions need repeated entry params and are not supported here), use
the form's 'Get pre-filled link' action, and read the ids out of the URL it
emits. That URL has exactly the shape this file records:
Put everything up to and including /viewform in form_url, and the numeric ids
in entries. Any entry left empty is simply not prefilled.
claim_url is REQUIRED: without it a response cannot be traced back to the claim
it is about, which is the whole point. It is also the field that makes claim_text
truncation harmless, since the full text is one click away.
